ledgerSearch.outcome: CTD-0088 requires an accessible alternative and an unpressured right to decline for every practice, and particular care for silence, touch, breath work, altered states, and disclosure. The shipped safeguarding paragraph is kept whole.

substitutionCheck: Grepped. The whole safeguarding paragraph and the paragraph on rhythm and the meal taken slowly are absent from the baseline. Both are retained, the first as CTD-0088 paydown and the second because the card names the slow meal a read aloud quality of the volume.

findings.summary: The passage through the initiates lost its four practices.

evidence.baseline: the deliberate perception of taste at a shared meal taken slowly; the witnessing of one another in council, where each is beheld rather than judged; the channeling of life-force in movement and breath; the making of art that asks nothing of skill and everything of attention
evidence.shipped: Shared meals, council, movement, breath, and art could carry the group through the Initiates.

findings.diagnosis: Each of the four names the tenet it enacts, which is the only place in the volume where the tenets are shown being practiced in a room. Asks nothing of skill and everything of attention is the sentence that tells a nervous participant what is expected of them. The shipped list names the activities and drops the practice.

findings.summary: The arc of the retreat as the whole work in miniature was cut.

evidence.baseline: The arc of a retreat is the arc of the whole work in miniature, from listening, through intimacy and balance and art and embodiment, toward worship and the providence of returning home changed.

findings.authorizedBy: Catalog 4.4 applied to the seven step roll.
findings.diagnosis: The card names ritual repetition of the seven among the volume’s protected devices, and the polysyndeton is the slowing before returning home changed. This is also the sentence that connects Part IX back to Part V and shows the structure is fractal rather than decorative.

debtImpact.note: The purpose, alternative, and right to decline requirement is kept, as is the list of practices needing particular care.
